feeds.title: Wellness Travel BC Blog
feeds.description: The Wellness Travel BC Blog includes stories and profiles from around the province on wellness, wellness travel, and living your best life. Wellness Travel BC is a collective of unique travel partners that engages wellness travel consumers to look, then book authentic experiences for renewal, rejuvenation, and re-energizing at remarkable settings throughout British Columbia.

feeds.title: Wellness Travel Diaries Blog
feeds.description: Here you can explore posts about my obsession between all things wellness-focused and travel related. You'll also find wellness travel destinations, outdoor adventures, plant-based food, and travel tips for staying healthy on the road. I'm Ciara, but family and friends call me Cees. I'm a SoCal native who loves traveling the globe both solo and with my amazing husband, Evan. I've visited over 29 countries, 15 national parks and forests, and taken countless road trips throughout the US.

feeds.title: Health and Fitness Travel Blog
feeds.description: The leading experts in health and fitness holidays offering tailor-made luxury wellness retreats worldwide from spa, detox, yoga, weight loss & sports. With Health and Fitness Travel your holiday starts the moment you get in touch and we are confident on delivering our promise - of an incredible wellness holiday. It's not just our comprehensive knowledge and service that guarantees you a holiday to remember, but our attention to the small important details that make the difference in selecting the right personalized holiday to ensure you return feeling happier and being healthier.

feeds.title: Wellness Tourism Association
feeds.description: Keep up to date with the latest news and insights, events and education opportunities from the Wellness Tourism Association. The WTA is the voice of the wellness tourism industry. The Wellness Tourism Association (WTA) is a global network for qualifying DMOs, Hotels/Resorts/Retreats, Tour Operators, Travel Advisors, Wellness Practitioners, Media, Partners, and others in the growing global wellness tourism industry.

feeds.title: True Wind Healing Travel
feeds.description: True Wind Healing Travel is a Wellness and Travel website, named metaphorically after me, the Author & Photographer, Trudy Wendelin. Ultimately, my life gives me joy and meaning, helping others find their True Wind for a healing journey.

feeds.title: Roam & Thrive
feeds.description: I'm Alex. Roam & Thrive is a female-centered travel blog made to inspire you to do just that. It's designed to feed your wanderlust while maintaining a healthy, active, and sustainable lifestyle. We aim to inspire and educate with unique curated guides and travel-focused wellness tips and workouts. Follow Roam & Thrive, the travel blog for everything wellness-focused travel. Find out how to travel the world healthily and sustainably.

feeds.title: Travel to Wellness
feeds.description: Launched in 2004, Travel to Wellness was the first online travel magazine and resource for the wellness-minded traveler. The wellness travel-focused publication continues to cover wellness living and wellness travel with new articles posted on a regular basis.

feeds.title: Beau Monde Traveler » Wellness
feeds.description: Beau Monde Traveler is the ultimate destination where today's affluent traveller goes to learn, explore and plan their next lavish vacation experience. It is more than a magazine; it is a media platform that shares information through original content, engaging video, print and digital media. Beau Monde is the platform where the next destination, hotel and haute experience is explored by the discerning traveller. Explore the wellness travel tips and guides here.

feeds.title: Inspired Journey Consulting Blog
feeds.description: Want expert insight into the health and wellbeing travel industry? Check out our blog to learn advice, tips, and tricks. Inspired Journey brings wellness to travel professionals & curated training for wellness resorts.

feeds.title: Compare Retreats Magazine
feeds.description: Compare Retreats is the booking portal and publication for the world's leading luxury wellness retreats that have been tried, tested, and reviewed by certified health and fitness professionals.

feeds.title: Dr Prem Wellness Tourism
feeds.description: Wellness Tourism Guide, Consultancy & Magazine by Dr. Prem Jagyasi and Team of a comprehensive Wellness Magazine and Wellness Tourism Guide for wellness enthusiasts with definition, meaning, terms, technology, trends, and the latest update on the Wellness Tourism Industry.

feeds.title: Pure Wellness Blog
feeds.description: Pure Wellness promotes wellbeing in a guest room or designed space by providing purified air, a hypoallergenic environment, and allergy-friendly options to help wellness-minded individuals be their best.

feeds.title: Vacayou Wellness Travel
feeds.description: Vacayou Magazine delivers wellness lifestyle and travel inspiration to a like-minded community of wellness-conscious people who are invested in maximizing their well-being - both inside and out. Our mission is to inspire, motivate and educate with practical tips and real-life experiences that empower our readers to blaze their own wellness trails.

feeds.title: Postcard Jar » Wellness Travel
feeds.description: Hello! We're empty nesters Ann and Steve Teget and we want to inspire you to take the next step on your journey. Whether that means finding a new travel destination, developing a healthier lifestyle, or just getting dinner on the table - we're here for YOU! Read our articles on Wellness Travel, covering a wide range of travel tips, and ideas.

feeds.title: Spa & Wellness Blog
feeds.description: Through our wellness travel blog, venture into the wonderful world of Spa & Wellness. Let's talk about the latest topic for the wellness-seeking consumer. We are the region's most comprehensive Spa & Wellness directory, with a delicious mix of luxury, sustainability, accessibility and fun. Spa & Wellness delivers the best spots to relax, revive, retreat and restore with a touch of beauty, and sprinkle of interesting interviews with people who do wonderful things in our world.

feeds.title: Wander Magazine
feeds.description: Launched in 2015, Wander was one of the first platforms to focus exclusively on the emerging intersection of wellness & travel. Through its lifestyle magazine, Wander curates and shares inspiring stories of unique destination-based experiences, soulful retreats, luxurious spas, active adventures, and culinary journeys for adventure seekers and wellness enthusiasts.

feeds.title: The Wellness Travel Expert Blog
feeds.description: Samantha Lippiatt is the wellness travel expert. She loves booking wellness holidays that improve your mental health and physical wellbeing. Her goal is to have you return feeling healthier and better than when you left! Experience the best health and wellness retreats to relax your mind, strengthen your body and bring joy to your soul. Programs include emotional healing, detox, fitness, rejuvenation, anti-ageing, yoga, Pilates, healing, stress relief and more.

feeds.title: Premiere Wellness Travel Blog
feeds.description: Here's where you'll find inspiration and insights on travel & wellness - usually, both at the same time! We believe in the transformational power of travel and love to craft unique, life-changing travel that inspires you to create a life that you don't crave an escape from. We design travel that will refresh, restore, and reinvigorate you. And we ensure your travel honors cultural heritage, supports local economies, and values the planet.

feeds.title: Jessie on a Journey Blog
feeds.description: Taking conscious solo travelers beyond the guidebook to discover unique experiences & local adventures. Jessie on a Journey offers an honest look into the adventures, advice, and detours of your travel blogging. And for those wanting to learn how to become digital nomads themselves, you'll find loads of free professional blogging resources as well as in-depth blog posts.

feeds.title: LUX Nomade
feeds.description: Founded in 2017 the magazine has naturally and organically expanded beyond luxury travel to embrace mindfulness, wellness, food, and beauty. Jampacked with knowledge, wisdom, and inspiration of today's thought leaders who grant exclusive interviews and regular contributors sharing their insights and expertise on wellness travel, fitness, food, beauty, hotels, retreats, spas, and more.

feeds.title: Movement Travel Blog
feeds.description: With a combined experience of over 30 years in the finance industry and 40 years traveling the world, co-founders, Lisa Gordon, and Melanie Yip, decided to pursue their shared passion for travel and wellness and established Movement Travel in 2018. Movement Travel gives you access to premium travel brands and exclusive VIP privileges with select partners.

feeds.title: Lost Girl On Earth
feeds.description: Hey! I'm Steph. Welcome to my blog! the focus of my blog is shifting from general travel and backpacking tips to traveling for wellness. I've always looked for ways to maintain and improve my health, and my love for travel is still strong. Now, I'm combing the two: Travel Well FKA Lost Girl On Earth, is now a blog focusing on wellness and travel experiences, both in Berlin and abroad.

feeds.title: Be Blissful Travel
feeds.description: Be Blissful Travel is a wellness-focused travel blog. We are two traveling girls focused on wellness and well-being and have launched this new venture to provide information about high-quality experiences in the form of yoga retreats, spas, meditation workshops, and more. Our mission is to empower people with travel that can create balance in both mind and body while providing an opportunity for self-discovery through purposeful journeys.

feeds.title: Terra & Tu Blog
feeds.description: Wellness travel, yoga retreats, and much, much more. Whether you're planning your next vacation or simply want to learn more about wellness travel, we've got you covered. At Terra & Tu, we believe deeply in the value of travel. Equally as important are personal growth and a mindful approach to life. It is at this intersection of exploration and wellness that Terra & Tu was born. On our journeys, we discover both the destination and ourselves.

feeds.title: Wellness Travelled
feeds.description: Don't just be well travelled, travel well. Blog dedicated to healthy, active, sustainable, and nature-focused travel. Our mission is to empower travellers to make informed and thoughtful travel decisions that are kind to themselves, the locals, and the planet. Whether it's promoting ethical animal tourism, eco-friendly hotels, plant-based restaurants, or zero waste travel products, Wellness Travelled can give you the tools you need to be a more environmentally and health conscious traveller.

feeds.title: O. Christine Blog
feeds.description: Find outdoor adventure travel inspiration, wellness getaway ideas, culture trips, vacation itineraries, and wellness advice for a life well lived. I'm Olivia Christine, I'm a writer, photographer, content creator, and the outdoor and wellness travel expert behind O. Christine: a blog inspiring people to prioritize travel and wellness, invest in experiences and connect with the outdoors.

feeds.title: The Travel Yogi Blog
feeds.description: The Travel Yogi Blog focuses on the intersection of travel and yoga. It shares information, tips, and insights on how to incorporate yoga into your travel experiences. The blog covers a wide range of topics related to travel, wellness, yoga retreats, and destinations that offer unique opportunities for yoga practitioners.
